# Dev Status
<!-- DO NOT EDIT this file directly. It is maintained by fhc sync and will be overwritten.
     Source: templates/skills/dev-status/SKILL.md in fh-commons -->

Show status of dev vs prod environments.

## Instructions

Use `flu git dev-status` to compare development and production environments.

## Usage

```bash
flu git dev-status
```

This command shows the synchronization status between development and production environments.

Execute `flu git dev-status` to see the current environment status.

### Memory Context (if available)

After gathering status, optionally check memory for environment history:

```
Use the mem-search skill to find:
- Recent deployment observations or environment issues
- Known dev/prod configuration differences
- Ongoing infrastructure concerns
```

Include any relevant historical context in the status report.
